findings.highlight: After doing a circuit of the neighborhoods, we return to the intersection.
findings.evidenceJa: 住宅地を一通り回って交差点に降りる。
findings.governingReading: After circling the residential area, they descend to the intersection.
findings.explanation: Descending to the intersection becomes returning to it.

findings.highlight: Any hesitation disappeared the moment I risked my life.
findings.evidenceJa: 躊躇いは死にかけた時に消えている。
findings.governingReading: In both patrol branches Shirou says his hesitation vanished when he was on the verge of death.
findings.explanation: Hesitation disappearing when Shirou nearly died becomes disappearing when he risked his life.

findings.highlight: But now, my body won't listen to my brain.
findings.evidenceJa: なのに体は動かず、頭は次の行動を命じてくれない。
findings.governingReading: His body will not move, and his head will not tell it what to do next: both thought and action are arrested.
findings.explanation: A body that will not move and a mind that issues no command become a body disobeying its mind.

findings.highlight: "The scream stopped. The presence we sensed is fading. I don't know what just happened, but I doubt we'll be able to help whoever was attacked."
findings.evidenceJa: 「悲鳴が止みました。感じ取れる気配も消えかけています。何が起きたかは判りませんが、このままでは襲われた者は助からないでしょう」
findings.governingReading: Saber says that if things continue this way, the attacked person will not be saved, despite not knowing what happened.
findings.explanation: The victim not surviving if they remain still becomes doubt that the pair can help.

findings.highlight: the fear of an imminent battle of life and death.
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かを見殺しにするのだ、という恐れにかき消された。
findings.governingReading: Shirou's fear of a death match is drowned out by fear that he will leave someone to die through inaction.
findings.explanation: Fear of letting someone die becomes fear of merely watching someone die.
